USC events calendar location 'Admission Center - Steven and Kathryn Sample Hall (SKS)' (calendar.usc.edu, checked 2026-11-24), and the team. building_name fixes OSM's 'Katherine' (the id keeps it so links don't break). Guided tours check in at the Admission Center; self-guided tours need no check-in (admission.usc.edu Tours page), so no alias for them. The door used is the team-surveyed one facing International Plaza; whether it is the nearest to the Admission Center is not checked.
